name: New Kargath
summary: New Kargath does not exist in this era. The primary Horde outpost within the Badlands remains original Kargath, nestled firmly against the western cliffs overlooking the dusty basin.

sections.title: The Only Outpost
sections.body: Travelers seeking Horde forces in the Badlands will find only the fortified camp of Kargath on the western rim. No settlement called 'New Kargath' exists. For now, Warchief Thrall's scouts and warriors maintain their solitary desert watch strictly from original Kargath.

aliases: how do i find new kargath
faq.answer: New Kargath does not exist in the present year. You are looking for the original settlement of Kargath, which is situated against the mountains along the western edge of the Badlands.
No such settlement exists. In the present era of 25 ADP, original Kargath stands intact as the lone Horde stronghold in the Badlands.

faq.q: What Horde hub should I use in the Badlands instead?
faq.answer: The outpost of Kargath provides all the necessary amenities for Horde champions, including a flight master, provisions, and shelter amidst the arid waste.

angles.text: Do not look for newer bastions atop the bluffs; report directly to Kargath along the western border for orders and resupply.
